neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were walking together when the accused stabbed the victim multiple times with a knife. The victim fell to the ground and later died at a hospital. A reliable eyewitness reported seeing the accused stab the victim. The knife used in the crime was recovered from the accused shortly after the incident. Forensic evidence confirmed that the victim's blood was found on the knife, and the injuries sustained by the victim were consistent with the weapon used. The accused was arrested and charged with murder.
